edge_board.description: Anthropic’s official September 1, 2026 announcement of Claude Mythos 5.1, featuring improved cybersecurity and biology capabilities with continued restricted access via trusted programs, serves as the primary catalyst anchoring trader consensus on the next Mythos-class release. This follows the June 2026 launch of Mythos 5 and Fable 5, reflecting the lab’s compressed post-safety-classifier timelines and completed internal training runs reported in August. Competitive pressure from OpenAI’s GPT variants and Google’s frontier efforts reinforces expectations of rapid iteration, while regulatory scrutiny on dual-use capabilities and benchmark validation remain key swing factors that could still shift exact timing. Market-implied odds reflect skin-in-the-game assessment of Anthropic’s established cadence rather than speculation.
edge_board.question: Next Mythos-Class Model released by September 1, 2026?
edge_board.resolution_criteria:
On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released the Mythos-class model Claude Fable 5.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Anthropic releases the next Mythos-class model and makes it available to the general public by the listed date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

Any model whose official name includes “Mythos,” or that Anthropic officially describes as a “Mythos-class” model or similar, will qualify for this market’s resolution.

For this market to resolve to "Yes," the qualifying model (as defined above) must be launched and publicly accessible, including via open beta or open rolling waitlist signups. A closed beta or any form of private access will not suffice. The release must be clearly defined and publicly announced by Anthropic as being accessible to the general public.

If a qualifying model is made publicly accessible and labeled with the relevant version name within the company’s official website, this will qualify as “publicly announced”. Labeling errors, placeholder text, or version names displayed on the website that do not correspond to a model that is actually accessible to the general public under the rules will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Anthropic; however,  a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

edge_board.description: United Russia maintains a commanding position in the upcoming State Duma election due to its long-standing parliamentary majority, extensive regional networks, and alignment with the executive branch. The party's organizational advantages and control over candidate registration processes have historically translated into seat majorities under Russia's mixed electoral system. New People, the second-favored outcome, draws from younger and urban voter segments but operates within the same constrained multiparty environment where smaller parties face high thresholds and limited media access. Recent candidate list approvals and campaign activity have reinforced trader expectations that established pro-government forces will again lead seat totals, while minor parties remain marginal. The September timing leaves little room for major shifts before voting concludes.
edge_board.question: Will United Russia (ER) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
edge_board.resolution_criteria:
Parliamentary elections are to be scheduled to be held in Russia in September 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that gains the greatest number of seats in the next Russian State Duma election, compared to before the election.

If the results are not known definitively by September 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties for the most seats gained, this market will resolve in favor of the party that received a greater number of valid votes. In the event that results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed abbreviation appears first in alphabetical order.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats gained by the named party in the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results reported by Russian government sources such as the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation.

edge_board.question: Will any company announce that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) before Oct 1, 2026?
edge_board.resolution_criteria: If any company (public or private) officially announces that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) after market issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. To qualify, the announcement must explicitly state that the company has achieved, attained, reached, or developed Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), or that it has achieved, attained, reached, or developed “AGI.” Statements that describe “AGI-like,” “AGI-level,” “near-AGI,” or “toward AGI” systems without explicitly stating that the company has achieved/attained/reached/developed AGI do not qualify. For purposes of this market, a “company” includes any publicly traded company or any privately held company whose existence and corporate identity is verifiable and whose financing/valuation or corporate profile is covered by at least two of the listed major business news sources.

edge_board.description: Elevated inflation pressures from Middle East supply shocks, particularly higher energy prices, combined with a resilient labor market and solid economic growth, underpin the 70.5% market-implied probability of at least one Federal Reserve rate hike in 2026. The federal funds rate has held steady at 3.50%-3.75% through mid-2026 amid these factors, with the June dot plot showing nine of 19 participants projecting at least one increase by year-end. Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish communications, including emphasis on the 2% inflation target and concerns over financial conditions, have reinforced trader expectations. Markets currently price roughly 60% odds of a September hike, with key catalysts including upcoming CPI and employment data plus the September 15-16 FOMC meeting.
edge_board.question: Fed rate hike in 2026?
edge_board.resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is increased at any point between January 1, 2026 and the Fed's December 2026 meeting, currently scheduled for December 8-9, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market may not resolve to "No" until the Fed has released its rate change decision following its December meeting.

The primary resolution source for this market will be the official website of the Federal Reserve (https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm), however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

edge_board.description: The dominant 98.7% implied probability for Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look stems from its massive pre-release hype and strategic Netflix positioning this week, driven by years of fan anticipation for the Rockstar title and proven trailer viewership records that routinely eclipse standard film releases. Traders view the extended look as the clear frontrunner based on current social momentum and platform placement. An upset remains possible if an unexpected major theatrical-to-streaming drop or breakout original title surges in the final days before rankings finalize.
edge_board.question: Will "The Whisper Man (2026)" be the top US Netflix movie this week?
edge_board.resolution_criteria:
Netflix is expected to update its Top 10 movies list on top10.netflix.com on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, 3:00 PM ET, reflecting viewership from the previous week (Monday to Sunday).

This market will resolve based on which movie this update ranks as the #1 US Netflix movie. If multiple movies tie for #1, this market will resolve according to the movie whose listed title comes first alphabetically.

The ranking is based on total views in the United States, as reported by Netflix for US Top 10 Movies.

If the top10.netflix.com update does not occur by September 4, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

edge_board.description: **Elevated inflation readings and hawkish signals from the Federal Open Committee have positioned a 25-basis-point rate increase as the slight favorite ahead of the September 15-16 meeting.** PCE inflation has remained sticky near 3.5–4.1% year-over-year, well above the 2% target and supported by energy price pressures tied to Middle East supply disruptions. The July hold drew three dissents favoring a hike, while Chair Warsh’s recent remarks have reinforced the case for tighter policy to restore credibility. Softer July employment data and cooling labor market indicators have kept a no-change outcome competitive at roughly even odds with a hike. Market pricing reflects these crosscurrents, with larger moves or cuts remaining remote given the data trajectory.
edge_board.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
edge_board.resolution_criteria:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's September 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for September 15-16, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their September meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

edge_board.question: Will Alexander Zverev win the 2026 Men's US Open?
